critical_code_review_comments: routes/ash.py::chat — the system prompt embeds Python-repr'd lists of dicts into the string via f-string ({[{...} for e in ...]}). This works because Python renders repr, but produces prompt content that includes single quotes / None literals unfamiliar to the model. Consider json.dumps(...) for cleaner grounding.

routes/ash.py::chat — logger is referenced (line 172) but the module does not import logging. If EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing/errors, the except branch will itself raise NameError. Recommend: `import logging; logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` at top of file. (During testing the LLM worked so this path was not exercised.)

services/ash_scheduler.py::_maybe_send_daily_digest — silently returns when now.hour < digest_hour_utc; force_digest_now() delete+regenerates, so the hour guard on the immediate re-invoke inside force_digest_now can cause 'sent:false' before 08:00 UTC. Consider passing a `force=True` bypass into _maybe_send_daily_digest to make manual triggers always run regardless of hour.

components/AshChat.jsx — SESSION_KEY is a single global string; if multiple owners/managers share a browser, they will see each other's chat history. Consider keying by user email/id from localStorage.

pages/FinanceLedger.jsx — 45-line router works cleanly; children pages (Overview/Reports/AP/AR/Bank/Journals/COA) are all under /finance/*. All 7 tab panes rendered correctly with the correct data-testid roots.
